title: Programme 4.1 weather-archive admission - frozen sample manifest and pre-registered rules
frozen_before: any sample GRIB/zarr data retrieval and any field-level inventory; selection used only public file-existence metadata (OCF tree listing), dated schedule sources and plan documents

authority.handoff: Weather-archive admission executor handoff, Engineering Lead, 2026-09-23 (Owner-carried)

information_boundary.origin: D-1 12:00 fixed CET = D-1 11:00 UTC (inherited v1 convention, CP-15 protocol.origin.timestamp)
information_boundary.run: D-1 00 UTC initialization; admissible only if every required output was available before D-1 11:00 UTC
information_boundary.hour_starts: relative to D-1 00 UTC: CEST day h22..h45; CET day h23..h46; spring-forward day h23..h45 (23 h); fall-back day h22..h46 (25 h); union h22..h46

required_windows.rule: history [max(2019-01-01, W-728 d), D) applied to genuine warm-up and evaluation forecasts; W = first genuine warm-up delivery day from CP-15 lineage; required delivery days = first history start .. fold evaluation end; required runs = delivery day - 1 at 00 UTC
required_windows.boundary_resolution: Delivery day 2019-01-01 would need the 2018-12-31 00 UTC run, a pre-2019 input. It is not imported: weather inputs for delivery 2019-01-01 are structurally missing by the 2019 floor (to be handled by the 4.4D frozen missing-input fallback), are excluded from the archive-coverage denominator, and are not an archive gap. Earliest admissible run: 2019-01-01 00 UTC (delivery 2019-01-02).

GFS.product: NCEP GFS 0.25 deg pgrb2 operational forecast, 00 UTC cycle
GFS.endpoint_rule: Prefer AWS where it has the run (idx enables exact range reads); NCAR for runs AWS lacks. Cross-endpoint compatibility accepted only if target GRIB messages are byte-identical (sha256) on sampled overlap runs and inventory file sizes agree across the overlap.

fields.u_hub: UGRD:100 m above ground (documented height-above-ground level; near-hub)
fields.ssrd_component_note: GFS provides total DSWRF, counted as the radiation field; 6th slot recorded as not applicable

ICON.product: DWD ICON-EU 0.0625 deg regular lat-lon, 00 UTC cycle, archived by Open Climate Fix

fields.u_hub: UNSUPPORTED - archive carries only 10 m and isobaric u/v; pressure levels are not turbine heights; not retrieved

domain.box: lat 47.0..55.25 N, lon 5.5..15.5 E (Germany incl. margin); decoded evidence reports box statistics, not a zonal aggregation recipe

GFS.why: earliest admissible run (2019 floor); GFS v14 spectral; NCAR
first v15.1 FV3 00 UTC run (schema/model change 2019-06-12 12Z); NCAR
fall-back delivery 2020-10-25 (25 h); v15.1; folds 2-3; NCAR
first v16 00 UTC run (2021-03-22 12Z change; path adds atmos/); AWS decode + NCAR byte comparison
crisis peak inside fold 3 evaluation; AWS
spring-forward delivery 2026-03-29 inside fold 5 evaluation (NCAR-updating 2026 tail); AWS + NCAR byte comparison
last required run (fold 5 end 2026-04-07); AWS + NCAR byte comparison

ICON.why: earliest required run the archive can serve (fold 3 history start); early schema
last early-schema 00 UTC run before March 2023 schema change
new schema; spring-forward delivery 2023-03-26 (2024/2025 spring-forward runs are absent from the archive)
fold 4 earliest required run; new schema
fold 4 last required run; modern summer radiation

samples.substitution_rule: If a listed run proves absent/undecodable, record the failure (counts toward attempts) and substitute the nearest later existing run in the same category only when a category would otherwise be uncovered; never exceed 12 GFS + 12 ICON runs.

admission_rule.scope: archive x fold x field (u10, v10, u_hub, v_hub, radiation)
ADMIT_requires_all: authenticated/free access verified for the archive
inventory: every required D-1 00 UTC run in the fold window present with every required lead/step for the field (100%; runs lacking in one GFS endpoint may be supplied by the other)

field present per run (GFS: idx-verified where an idx exists; otherwise file present and size-consistent with its model version plus decoded layout of that version; ICON: zarr chunk objects covering the domain and steps present)
decoded samples of this archive covering the fold's model version/schema pass metadata, unit, averaging and alignment checks

reconstructed availability before D-1 11:00 UTC for the cycle and every required lead from dated producer-side evidence bracketing the fold window, with no documented intervening change that could move publication beyond the margin
admission_rule.otherwise: NOT_ADMITTED, classified as ARCHIVE_ABSENCE, FIELD_UNSUPPORTED, AVAILABILITY_UNPROVEN, ACCESS_GAP or BUDGET_GAP, with gap list and counts
admission_rule.not_claimed: Historical admission does not certify live suitability (4.9); schedules/averages do not prove uninterrupted delivery

decoding.bundle: one run: all native fields x required leads, decoded locally from raw bytes (eccodes 2.49 for GRIB2; zarr 2.18.7 + ocf_blosc2 for ICON)
